fields.summary: A builder's or fixer's commit whose Leaf: trailer sits before a Co-Authored-By paragraph was not counted, because git's trailer reader reads only the final paragraph. The owner picked the option where the trailer reader reads Change:, Actor:, Leaf: and Review: from every paragraph of a commit body. The build and review guides keep all trailers in one final paragraph, Co-Authored-By included.
